items.title: Is PayPal Holdings (PYPL) A Bargain On Its Leadership Shake Up?
items.summary: PayPal Holdings (PYPL) is back in focus after a broad leadership shake up that introduced a new chief financial officer and several senior executives tied to its multi year execution plan. Recent trading has been rough for PayPal Holdings, with the share price down 5.46% on the day and 10.10% over the past week, extending a 30 day share price decline of 7.38% and a 1 year total shareholder return fall of 11.24% as investors assess the leadership overhaul and the associated execution...

items.title: PayPal Sinks 5% on CFO Swap and Leadership Shake-Up as Clear Street Sees “Lower Likelihood” of Sale
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPayPal shares fell 5% after a CFO swap, new business heads and its risk chief’s exit. Clear Street sees a “lower likelihood” of a sale, so the turnaround has to work on its own.
